purpose: prospective familywise certification across held-out validation groups using replicate-specific cluster studentization
supersedes_for_new_endpoints: fixed-scale standardized max-deviation interval used by simultaneous-group v1

estimator.group_gain: ratio of weighted gain numerator sums to weighted mass sums over caller-declared exchangeable validation blocks
estimator.point_standard_error: cluster ratio influence standard error recomputed from the original validation blocks
estimator.bootstrap_draw: resample the original number of validation blocks with replacement within each independent group
estimator.replicate_standard_error: recompute the same cluster ratio influence standard error inside each bootstrap replicate
estimator.max_t_statistic: maximum across estimable groups of abs(theta_star - theta_hat) / se_star
estimator.interval: theta_hat plus/minus bootstrap-t critical value times the original cluster ratio standard error

zero_variance_rule.zero_se_nonzero_displacement: t contribution is infinity and the simultaneous interval fails conservatively
